normalized.answer: Exact words compared: 2002 B.1 item 48 and 2023 A.1 item 67 differ only in the apostrophe of 'implementor's' (curly in the 2002 transcription, straight in 2023); the requirement is the same and DOC-A.1-67 is the right pointer.

cross-reference.answer: Read §2002:8.13 whole: the same thirteen information items as §2023:8.13, ending 'any other information that the implementor requires', the same signature definition and the same two mechanism sentences (update; flag differences). 2002 adds an opening sentence naming the source units the repository holds and points at 12.2.7 where 2023 points at 12.3.8; neither changes the open-ended 'any other information' item this row documents.
